-- Lua 5.1 without the game/LuaJIT bit library. All masks here are nonnegative.
local function band(a,b)
  local n,p=0,1
  while a>0 and b>0 do
    if a%2==1 and b%2==1 then n=n+p end
    a,b,p=math.floor(a/2),math.floor(b/2),p*2
  end
  return n
end
ns.Bits=bit or bit32 or {band=band,bor=function(a,b)return a+b-band(a,b)end,lshift=function(a,b)return a*2^b end}

-- Binary min-heap keyed by a number. Used by Dijkstra and min-cost flow.
local _, ns = ...

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
  return setmetatable({ keys = {}, vals = {}, n = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(key, val)
  local n = self.n + 1
  self.n = n
  local keys, vals = self.keys, self.vals
  keys[n], vals[n] = key, val
  while n > 1 do
    local p = math.floor(n / 2)
    if keys[p] <= keys[n] then break end
    keys[p], keys[n] = keys[n], keys[p]
    vals[p], vals[n] = vals[n], vals[p]
    n = p
  end
end

function Heap:pop()
  local n = self.n
  if n == 0 then return nil end
  local keys, vals = self.keys, self.vals
  local topKey, topVal = keys[1], vals[1]
  keys[1], vals[1] = keys[n], vals[n]
  keys[n], vals[n] = nil, nil
  n = n - 1
  self.n = n
  local i = 1
  while true do
    local l, r, m = 2 * i, 2 * i + 1, i
    if l <= n and keys[l] < keys[m] then m = l end
    if r <= n and keys[r] < keys[m] then m = r end
    if m == i then break end
    keys[m], keys[i] = keys[i], keys[m]
    vals[m], vals[i] = vals[i], vals[m]
    i = m
  end
  return topKey, topVal
end

function Heap:empty() return self.n == 0 end

ns.Heap = Heap

-- Multimodal travel graph of the game world.
--
-- Nodes:
--   ground nodes  - places you can stand at (towns, quest spots, docks)
--   air nodes     - one per flight master, "in the flight network"
-- Edges (all costs in seconds):
--   walk      ground <-> ground, same continent, k nearest neighbours
--   board     ground -> air   (talking to the flight master; air nodes are faction-gated)
--   fly       air <-> air     (one flight link; chained links are one continuous flight)
--   land      air -> ground
--   boat / zeppelin / tram   ground <-> ground, cost = ride + expected wait (half a cycle)
-- Teleports (edges from *every* ground node, not stored per node):
--   mage teleports (class-gated), hearthstone (one use per plan: see router.lua)
--
-- Splitting each flight master into a ground and an air node is what lets a multi-hop flight
-- cost one boarding instead of one per hop, the same as the in-game taxi.
local _, ns = ...

local World = {}
World.__index = World

World.WALK_DETOUR = 1.3   -- roads and terrain vs. straight line
World.FLY_DETOUR = 1.15
World.FLY_SPEED = 30      -- yards / second, taxi
World.BOARD_TIME = 5      -- seconds to talk to the flight master
World.CAST_TIME = 10      -- hearthstone and mage teleport cast

function World.new()
  return setmetatable({
    nodes = {},       -- index -> node
    byId = {},        -- id -> index
    adj = {},         -- index -> list of edges
    teleports = {},   -- list of {to=index, mode=, cost=, faction=, class=}
    flightLinks = {}, -- list of {a=index, b=index} (air nodes)
  }, World)
end

local function dist(a, b)
  local dx, dy = a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y
  return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
end
World.dist = dist

function World:_add(node)
  local i = #self.nodes + 1
  node.index = i
  self.nodes[i] = node
  self.byId[node.id] = i
  self.adj[i] = {}
  return i
end

local GATES = { "faction", "class", "item", "spell", "unconfirmed", "name" }

function World:edge(from, to, mode, cost, gate)
  local e = { from = from, to = to, mode = mode, cost = cost }
  if gate then for _, k in ipairs(GATES) do e[k] = gate[k] end end
  local list = self.adj[from]
  list[#list + 1] = e
  return e
end

-- place = {id, name, zone, continent, x, y}
function World:addPlace(p)
  p.kind = "ground"
  return self:_add(p)
end

function World:index(id)
  local i = self.byId[id]
  if not i then error("unknown place: " .. tostring(id), 2) end
  return i
end

-- faction = "Alliance", "Horde" or nil (neutral); class = only that class may use it;
-- unconfirmed = only reported from the beta
function World:addFlightMaster(placeId, faction, class, unconfirmed)
  local g = self:index(placeId)
  local p = self.nodes[g]
  local a = self:_add({ id = "air:" .. placeId, name = p.name .. " (flight master)",
                        zone = p.zone, continent = p.continent, x = p.x, y = p.y,
                        kind = "air", ground = g, faction = faction, class = class })
  self:edge(g, a, "board", World.BOARD_TIME, { faction = faction, class = class, unconfirmed = unconfirmed })
  self:edge(a, g, "land", 0)
  return a
end

-- opts = {class = "DRUID", unconfirmed = true}
function World:addFlightLink(idA, idB, opts)
  opts = opts or {}
  local a, b = self:index("air:" .. idA), self:index("air:" .. idB)
  local na, nb = self.nodes[a], self.nodes[b]
  local cost = dist(na, nb) * World.FLY_DETOUR / World.FLY_SPEED
  -- a link is usable only if the rider's faction can use both ends
  local gate = { faction = na.faction or nb.faction, class = opts.class or na.class or nb.class,
                 unconfirmed = opts.unconfirmed }
  self:edge(a, b, "fly", cost, gate)
  self:edge(b, a, "fly", cost, gate)
  self.flightLinks[#self.flightLinks + 1] = { a = a, b = b }
end

-- t = {from, to, mode, ride, cycle, faction, oneWay, unconfirmed, name}
function World:addTransport(t)
  local a, b = self:index(t.from), self:index(t.to)
  local cost = t.ride + (t.cycle or 0) / 2
  local gate = { faction = t.faction, unconfirmed = t.unconfirmed, name = t.name }
  self:edge(a, b, t.mode, cost, gate)
  if not t.oneWay then self:edge(b, a, t.mode, cost, gate) end
end

-- t = {to | toBind, mode, cost, faction, class, item, spell, limited, unconfirmed, name}
--   limited  = usable once per plan (cooldown longer than a plan)
--   toBind   = goes to the hearthstone's bind location (Astral Recall)
--   item     = needs this item in the bags (engineering devices)
--   spell    = spell id, checked in game with IsSpellKnown
function World:addTeleport(t)
  self.teleports[#self.teleports + 1] = {
    to = t.to and self:index(t.to), toBind = t.toBind, mode = t.mode,
    cost = t.cost or World.CAST_TIME, faction = t.faction, class = t.class, item = t.item,
    spell = t.spell, limited = t.limited, unconfirmed = t.unconfirmed, name = t.name,
  }
end

-- Walking edges: each ground node to its k nearest ground nodes on the same continent,
-- in both directions, plus any explicit pairs given in `extra` (e.g. a mountain pass).
function World:connectWalking(k, extra)
  k = k or 4
  local ground = {}
  for i, n in ipairs(self.nodes) do
    if n.kind == "ground" then ground[#ground + 1] = i end
  end
  -- k-nearest only within a region (default: the continent); walled-off areas such as
  -- Mount Hyjal get their own region and are joined only by the explicit `extra` passes
  local function region(n) return n.region or n.continent end
  local has = {}
  local function link(i, j)
    local key = i < j and (i .. ":" .. j) or (j .. ":" .. i)
    if has[key] then return end
    has[key] = true
    local d = dist(self.nodes[i], self.nodes[j]) * World.WALK_DETOUR
    self:edge(i, j, "walk", d) -- cost in yards; the router divides by ground speed
    self:edge(j, i, "walk", d)
  end
  for _, i in ipairs(ground) do
    local cands = {}
    for _, j in ipairs(ground) do
      if j ~= i and region(self.nodes[j]) == region(self.nodes[i]) then
        cands[#cands + 1] = { j = j, d = dist(self.nodes[i], self.nodes[j]) }
      end
    end
    table.sort(cands, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
    for r = 1, math.min(k, #cands) do link(i, cands[r].j) end
  end
  for _, pair in ipairs(extra or {}) do link(self:index(pair[1]), self:index(pair[2])) end
end

-- Profile: what this character can use.
--   faction      "Alliance" | "Horde"
--   class        "MAGE", ... (upper-case, as UnitClass returns it)
--   speed        ground speed in yards/s (7 on foot, 11.2 with a 60% mount, 14 with 100%)
--   hearth       place id the hearthstone is bound to, or nil
--   items        set of item ids the character carries (engineering devices), or nil
--   knows        function(spellId) -> bool (in game: IsSpellKnown), or nil = trust the class
--   flySpeed     flight speed multiplier (Forever's Frequent Flier perk: 1.2)
--   unconfirmed  true = also use routes only reported from the beta
function World:allowed(gated, profile)
  if gated.faction and gated.faction ~= profile.faction then return false end
  if gated.class and gated.class ~= profile.class then return false end
  if gated.item and not (profile.items and profile.items[gated.item]) then return false end
  if gated.spell and profile.knows and not profile.knows(gated.spell) then return false end
  if gated.unconfirmed and not profile.unconfirmed then return false end
  return true
end

function World:edgeCost(e, profile)
  if e.mode == "walk" then return e.cost / (profile.speed or 7) end
  if e.mode == "fly" then return e.cost / (profile.flySpeed or 1) end
  return e.cost
end

ns.World = World

name: core/router
source:
-- Fastest route between two places: Dijkstra over (node, set of one-use teleports spent).
--
-- Some teleports have cooldowns longer than most plans, so each is treated as usable once:
-- the hearthstone, a shaman's Astral Recall, engineering devices. With K of them the state
-- is (node, spent-mask), 2^K states per node. Carrying the mask makes the search exact: a
-- route spends a teleport only where it pays, and the tour planner can read "fastest i -> j
-- that spends exactly the set C" straight from one search per origin.
local _, ns = ...
local Heap = ns.Heap

local Router = {}

local INF = math.huge

-- The one-use teleports this character has, in a fixed order (bit k-1 = item k).
function Router.limited(world, profile)
  local list = {}
  if profile.hearth then
    list[#list + 1] = { mode = "hearth", name = "Hearthstone", to = world:index(profile.hearth),
                        cost = world.CAST_TIME }
  end
  for _, t in ipairs(world.teleports) do
    if t.limited and world:allowed(t, profile) then
      local to = t.to
      if t.toBind then local bind = profile.bind or profile.hearth; to = bind and world:index(bind) end
      if to then
        list[#list + 1] = { mode = t.mode, name = t.name, to = to, cost = t.cost }
      end
    end
  end
  return list
end

-- ctx: what the state numbers mean for this character.
function Router.context(world, profile)
  local L = Router.limited(world, profile)
  local S = 1
  for _ = 1, #L do S = S * 2 end
  return { L = L, S = S }
end

local function sid(ctx, node, used) return node * ctx.S + used end
local function decode(ctx, s) return math.floor(s / ctx.S), s % ctx.S end
Router.sid, Router.decode = sid, decode

local function hasBit(mask, k) return math.floor(mask / 2 ^ (k - 1)) % 2 == 1 end
Router.hasBit = hasBit

-- Single-source search. allowLimited=false forbids every one-use teleport.
-- Returns dist[state], prev[state] = {state, edge}, ctx.
function Router.search(world, profile, src, allowLimited, ctx)
  ctx = ctx or Router.context(world, profile)
  local dist, prev = {}, {}
  local heap = Heap.new()
  local s = sid(ctx, src, 0)
  dist[s] = 0
  heap:push(0, s)

  local tps = {}
  for _, t in ipairs(world.teleports) do
    if not t.limited and world:allowed(t, profile) then tps[#tps + 1] = t end
  end
  local L = (allowLimited ~= false) and ctx.L or {}

  while not heap:empty() do
    local d, u = heap:pop()
    if d <= (dist[u] or INF) then
      local node, used = decode(ctx, u)
      local function relax(to, nused, cost, e)
        local v = sid(ctx, to, nused)
        local nd = d + cost
        if nd < (dist[v] or INF) then
          dist[v] = nd
          prev[v] = { state = u, edge = e }
          heap:push(nd, v)
        end
      end
      for _, e in ipairs(world.adj[node]) do
        if world:allowed(e, profile) then
          relax(e.to, used, world:edgeCost(e, profile), e)
        end
      end
      if world.nodes[node].kind == "ground" then -- no casting while on a flight
        for _, t in ipairs(tps) do relax(t.to, used, t.cost, t) end
        for k, t in ipairs(L) do
          if not hasBit(used, k) then relax(t.to, used + 2 ^ (k - 1), t.cost, t) end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return dist, prev, ctx
end

-- Rebuild the legs from the search result, with each leg's time taken from the distance
-- labels. Consecutive walks merge into one walk; board + fly hops + land become one flight
-- (from the flight master's ground node to the landing ground node).
function Router.legs(world, dist, prev, dstState, ctx)
  local steps = {}
  local v = dstState
  while prev[v] do
    local p = prev[v]
    steps[#steps + 1] = { from = decode(ctx, p.state), to = decode(ctx, v),
                          edge = p.edge, seconds = dist[v] - dist[p.state] }
    v = p.state
  end
  local legs = {}
  for i = #steps, 1, -1 do
    local st = steps[i]
    local mode = st.edge.mode
    local last = legs[#legs]
    if (mode == "fly" or mode == "land") and last and last.mode == "fly" then
      last.to = st.to
      last.seconds = last.seconds + st.seconds
      last.path[#last.path + 1] = st.to
      if mode == "fly" then last.hops = last.hops + 1 end
    elseif mode == "walk" and last and last.mode == "walk" then
      last.to = st.to
      last.seconds = last.seconds + st.seconds
      last.path[#last.path + 1] = st.to
    else
      -- path: every node the leg passes through, for drawing it on a map
      legs[#legs + 1] = { mode = (mode == "board") and "fly" or mode, from = st.from, to = st.to,
                          seconds = st.seconds, name = st.edge.name, hops = 0,
                          path = { st.from, st.to } }
    end
  end
  return legs
end

-- Best arrival state at node dst over every spent-mask: returns (seconds, state).
function Router.best(dist, ctx, dst)
  local best, state = INF, nil
  for used = 0, ctx.S - 1 do
    local s = sid(ctx, dst, used)
    local d = dist[s]
    if d and d < best then best, state = d, s end
  end
  return best, state
end

-- Convenience: fastest route from place id a to place id b.
-- Returns total seconds and a list of legs {mode, from, to, seconds}.
function Router.route(world, profile, a, b, allowLimited)
  local src, dst = world:index(a), world:index(b)
  local dist, prev, ctx = Router.search(world, profile, src, allowLimited)
  local best, state = Router.best(dist, ctx, dst)
  if not state then return nil end
  return best, Router.legs(world, dist, prev, state, ctx)
end

ns.Router = Router

name: core/tour
source:
-- Quest tour: the order to visit every quest stop (accept -> objectives -> turn in) that
-- minimises total travel time, using the multimodal router for every leg.
--
--   1. One Router.search from the start and from every stop, with every one-use teleport
--      available, gives D[i][j][C] = fastest i -> j spending exactly the teleport set C
--      (the search state is (node, spent set), so this is read off directly).
--   2. Ordering:
--        exact     Held-Karp DP over (visited stops, last stop, teleports spent), adding stop
--                  j only once its prerequisites are visited; each leg may spend any set C
--                  of teleports not spent yet. O(2^n * n^2 * 3^K) for K one-use teleports.
--        heuristic for larger logs: precedence-safe nearest-neighbour start, then Or-opt
--                  (move a block of 1-3 stops elsewhere) until no move helps. A fixed order's
--                  best use of the teleports is found exactly by a DP over legs.
--
-- Stops: { node = world index, quest = quest id, kind = "accept"|"objective"|"turnin",
--          work = seconds spent at the stop, after = {stop indices that must come first} }
local _, ns = ...
local Router = ns.Router

local bit = ns.Bits or bit or bit32
local band, bor, lshift = bit.band, bit.bor, bit.lshift

local Tour = {}
local INF = math.huge

-- Exact search is used while 2^n * n^2 * 3^K stays under this (13 stops with one teleport).
Tour.EXACT_BUDGET = 2 ^ 13 * 13 * 13 * 3

-- Turn quest definitions into stops. quest = {id, name, giver, objectives = {place ids},
-- turnin, accepted = bool, work = seconds per objective, requires = {quest ids}}
-- `requires`: quests in the same log that must be handed in before this one is picked up
-- (a quest chain). Required quests that are not in the log count as already done.
function Tour.stops(world, quests)
  local stops = {}
  local turninOf, firstOf = {}, {}
  for _, q in ipairs(quests) do
    firstOf[q.id] = #stops + 1
    local acceptIdx
    if not q.accepted then
      stops[#stops + 1] = { node = world:index(q.giver), quest = q.id, name = q.name,
                            kind = "accept", work = 0, after = {} }
      acceptIdx = #stops
    end
    local objIdx = {}
    for _, o in ipairs(q.objectives or {}) do
      if not (q.done and q.done[o]) then
        stops[#stops + 1] = { node = world:index(o), quest = q.id, name = q.name,
                              kind = "objective", work = q.work or 0,
                              after = acceptIdx and { acceptIdx } or {} }
        objIdx[#objIdx + 1] = #stops
      end
    end
    if q.turnin then
      local after = {}
      if acceptIdx then after[#after + 1] = acceptIdx end
      for _, i in ipairs(objIdx) do after[#after + 1] = i end
      stops[#stops + 1] = { node = world:index(q.turnin), quest = q.id, name = q.name,
                            kind = "turnin", work = 0, after = after }
      turninOf[q.id] = #stops
    end
  end
  for _, q in ipairs(quests) do
    for _, r in ipairs(q.requires or {}) do
      local t = turninOf[r]
      if t then
        for i = firstOf[q.id], #stops do
          if stops[i].quest ~= q.id then break end
          table.insert(stops[i].after, t)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return stops
end

-- Travel-time tables. Index 0 is the start node, 1..n the stops. D[i][j][C + 1].
function Tour.matrices(world, profile, startNode, stops)
  local ctx = Router.context(world, profile)
  local pts = { [0] = startNode }
  for i, s in ipairs(stops) do pts[i] = s.node end
  local D, cache = {}, {}
  for i = 0, #stops do
    local src = pts[i]
    local res = cache[src]
    if not res then
      local dist, prev = Router.search(world, profile, src, true, ctx)
      res = { dist = dist, prev = prev }
      cache[src] = res
    end
    D[i] = {}
    for j = 1, #stops do
      local row = {}
      for C = 0, ctx.S - 1 do
        row[C + 1] = res.dist[Router.sid(ctx, pts[j], C)] or INF
      end
      D[i][j] = row
    end
  end
  return { D = D, S = ctx.S, ctx = ctx, pts = pts, cache = cache }
end

-- Cost of a fixed order with the best use of the one-use teleports.
-- Returns cost and, per leg, the teleport set it spends.
function Tour.orderCost(M, order, stops)
  local S = M.S
  local best = { [0] = 0 }
  local parents = {}
  local prev = 0
  for k, j in ipairs(order) do
    local nb, par = {}, {}
    local row = M.D[prev][j]
    local w = stops[j].work
    for U, c in pairs(best) do
      for C = 0, S - 1 do
        if band(C, U) == 0 then
          local d = row[C + 1]
          if d < INF then
            local nu = bor(U, C)
            local v = c + d + w
            if v < (nb[nu] or INF) then nb[nu] = v; par[nu] = { U, C } end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    best = nb
    parents[k] = par
    prev = j
  end
  local cost, U = INF, nil
  for u, c in pairs(best) do if c < cost then cost, U = c, u end end
  if not U then return INF, {} end
  local spend = {}
  for k = #order, 1, -1 do
    local p = parents[k][U]
    spend[k] = p[2]
    U = p[1]
  end
  return cost, spend
end

local function feasible(order, stops)
  if #order ~= #stops then return false end
  local pos = {}
  for k, j in ipairs(order) do
    if not stops[j] or pos[j] then return false end
    pos[j] = k
  end
  for k, j in ipairs(order) do
    for _, p in ipairs(stops[j].after) do
      if (pos[p] or INF) >= k then return false end
    end
  end
  return true
end
Tour.feasible = feasible

-- Exact Held-Karp. `yield` (optional) is called every few thousand states so the game can
-- run it in a coroutine without freezing a frame.
function Tour.exact(M, stops, yield)
  local n, S = #stops, M.S
  local need = {}
  for j = 1, n do
    local m = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(stops[j].after) do m = bor(m, lshift(1, p - 1)) end
    need[j] = m
  end
  local W = n + 1
  local function key(mask, last, U) return (mask * W + last) * S + U end
  local dp, par = {}, {}
  for j = 1, n do
    if need[j] == 0 then
      for C = 0, S - 1 do
        local d = M.D[0][j][C + 1]
        if d < INF then
          local k = key(lshift(1, j - 1), j, C)
          local v = d + stops[j].work
          if v < (dp[k] or INF) then dp[k] = v; par[k] = -1 end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local full = lshift(1, n) - 1
  local steps = 0
  for mask = 1, full do
    for last = 1, n do
      if band(mask, lshift(1, last - 1)) ~= 0 then
        for U = 0, S - 1 do
          local k0 = key(mask, last, U)
          local cur = dp[k0]
          if cur then
            for j = 1, n do
              local bj = lshift(1, j - 1)
              if band(mask, bj) == 0 and band(mask, need[j]) == need[j] then
                local row, w = M.D[last][j], stops[j].work
                local nm = bor(mask, bj)
                for C = 0, S - 1 do
                  if band(C, U) == 0 then
                    local d = row[C + 1]
                    if d < INF then
                      local nk = key(nm, j, bor(U, C))
                      local v = cur + d + w
                      if v < (dp[nk] or INF) then dp[nk] = v; par[nk] = k0 end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        steps = steps + 1
        if yield and steps % 2000 == 0 then yield() end
      end
    end
  end
  local best, bk = INF, nil
  for last = 1, n do
    for U = 0, S - 1 do
      local c = dp[key(full, last, U)]
      if c and c < best then best, bk = c, key(full, last, U) end
    end
  end
  if not bk then return nil end
  local order = {}
  local k = bk
  while k and k >= 0 do
    local last = math.floor(k / S) % W
    table.insert(order, 1, last)
    k = par[k]
  end
  return order, best
end

-- Heuristic: nearest feasible stop first, then Or-opt with blocks of 1..3.
function Tour.heuristic(M, stops, yield)
  local n = #stops
  local done, order = {}, {}
  local prev = 0
  for _ = 1, n do
    local best, bj, fallback = INF, nil, nil
    for j = 1, n do
      if not done[j] then
        local ok = true
        for _, p in ipairs(stops[j].after) do if not done[p] then ok = false; break end end
        if ok then
          if M.D[prev][j][1] < best then best, bj = M.D[prev][j][1], j end
          -- Consider one-use connectors only for a prefix that can actually afford them.
          if not bj and not fallback then
            order[#order + 1] = j
            if Tour.orderCost(M, order, stops) < INF then fallback = j end
            order[#order] = nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
    bj = bj or fallback
    if not bj then return nil end
    done[bj] = true
    order[#order + 1] = bj
    prev = bj
  end
  local cost = Tour.orderCost(M, order, stops)
  local improved = true
  while improved do
    improved = false
    for len = 1, 3 do
      for i = 1, n - len + 1 do
        local block = {}
        for k = i, i + len - 1 do block[#block + 1] = order[k] end
        local rest = {}
        for k = 1, n do if k < i or k >= i + len then rest[#rest + 1] = order[k] end end
        for pos = 0, #rest do
          if pos ~= i - 1 then
            local cand = {}
            for k = 1, pos do cand[#cand + 1] = rest[k] end
            for _, b in ipairs(block) do cand[#cand + 1] = b end
            for k = pos + 1, #rest do cand[#cand + 1] = rest[k] end
            if feasible(cand, stops) then
              local c = Tour.orderCost(M, cand, stops)
              if c < cost - 1e-9 then
                order, cost, improved = cand, c, true
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if improved then break end
      end
      if improved then break end
    end
    if yield then yield() end
  end
  return order, cost
end

function Tour.exactAffordable(n, S)
  local K = 0
  while 2 ^ K < S do K = K + 1 end
  return 2 ^ n * n * n * 3 ^ K <= Tour.EXACT_BUDGET
end

-- Full plan. opts = {method = "auto"|"exact"|"heuristic", yield = fn}
-- Returns {order, seconds, method, stops, legs = {{stop, seconds, travel}}, matrices}
-- or nil and {code, message} for a bound or a failed complete tour.
function Tour.plan(world, profile, startId, quests, opts)
  opts = opts or {}
  local stops = Tour.stops(world, quests)
  local startNode = world:index(startId)
  local M = Tour.matrices(world, profile, startNode, stops)
  local method = opts.method or "auto"
  if method == "auto" then method = Tour.exactAffordable(#stops, M.S) and "exact" or "heuristic" end
  if method == "exact" and not Tour.exactAffordable(#stops, M.S) then
    return nil, {code="bound", message="Exact search exceeds the state budget. Choose automatic planning or fewer stops."}
  end
  local order
  if #stops == 0 then
    order = {}
  elseif method == "exact" then
    order = Tour.exact(M, stops, opts.yield)
  else
    order = Tour.heuristic(M, stops, opts.yield)
  end
  if not order or not feasible(order, stops) then
    return nil, {code=method == "exact" and "unreachable" or "no_extension",
      message="No complete route found with these travel options and quest prerequisites."}
  end
  local seconds, spend = Tour.orderCost(M, order, stops)
  local legs = {}
  local prev = 0
  for k, j in ipairs(order) do
    local res = M.cache[M.pts[prev]]
    local state = Router.sid(M.ctx, stops[j].node, spend[k])
    local travel = Router.legs(world, res.dist, res.prev, state, M.ctx)
    legs[#legs + 1] = { stop = stops[j], index = j, seconds = res.dist[state], travel = travel }
    prev = j
  end
  return { order = order, seconds = seconds, method = method, stops = stops,
           legs = legs, matrices = M }
end

local json = { _version = "0.1.2" }

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Encode
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local encode

local escape_char_map = {
  [ "\\" ] = "\\\\",
  [ "\"" ] = "\\\"",
  [ "\b" ] = "\\b",
  [ "\f" ] = "\\f",
  [ "\n" ] = "\\n",
  [ "\r" ] = "\\r",
  [ "\t" ] = "\\t",
}

local escape_char_map_inv = { [ "\\/" ] = "/" }
for k, v in pairs(escape_char_map) do
  escape_char_map_inv[v] = k
end


local function escape_char(c)
  return escape_char_map[c] or string.format("\\u%04x", c:byte())
end


local function encode_nil(val)
  return "null"
end


local function encode_table(val, stack)
  local res = {}
  stack = stack or {}

  -- Circular reference?
  if stack[val] then error("circular reference") end

  stack[val] = true

  if rawget(val, 1) ~= nil or next(val) == nil then
    -- Treat as array -- check keys are valid and it is not sparse
    local n = 0
    for k in pairs(val) do
      if type(k) ~= "number" then
        error("invalid table: mixed or invalid key types")
      end
      n = n + 1
    end
    if n ~= #val then
      error("invalid table: sparse array")
    end
    -- Encode
    for i, v in ipairs(val) do
      table.insert(res, encode(v, stack))
    end
    stack[val] = nil
    return "[" .. table.concat(res, ",") .. "]"

  else
    -- Treat as an object
    for k, v in pairs(val) do
      if type(k) ~= "string" then
        error("invalid table: mixed or invalid key types")
      end
      table.insert(res, encode(k, stack) .. ":" .. encode(v, stack))
    end
    stack[val] = nil
    return "{" .. table.concat(res, ",") .. "}"
  end
end


local function encode_string(val)
  return '"' .. val:gsub('[%z\1-\31\\"]', escape_char) .. '"'
end


local function encode_number(val)
  -- Check for NaN, -inf and inf
  if val ~= val or val <= -math.huge or val >= math.huge then
    error("unexpected number value '" .. tostring(val) .. "'")
  end
  return string.format("%.14g", val)
end


local type_func_map = {
  [ "nil"     ] = encode_nil,
  [ "table"   ] = encode_table,
  [ "string"  ] = encode_string,
  [ "number"  ] = encode_number,
  [ "boolean" ] = tostring,
}


encode = function(val, stack)
  local t = type(val)
  local f = type_func_map[t]
  if f then
    return f(val, stack)
  end
  error("unexpected type '" .. t .. "'")
end


function json.encode(val)
  return ( encode(val) )
end


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Decode
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local parse

local function create_set(...)
  local res = {}
  for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
    res[ select(i, ...) ] = true
  end
  return res
end

local space_chars   = create_set(" ", "\t", "\r", "\n")
local delim_chars   = create_set(" ", "\t", "\r", "\n", "]", "}", ",")
local escape_chars  = create_set("\\", "/", '"', "b", "f", "n", "r", "t", "u")
local literals      = create_set("true", "false", "null")

local literal_map = {
  [ "true"  ] = true,
  [ "false" ] = false,
  [ "null"  ] = nil,
}


local function next_char(str, idx, set, negate)
  for i = idx, #str do
    if set[str:sub(i, i)] ~= negate then
      return i
    end
  end
  return #str + 1
end


local function decode_error(str, idx, msg)
  local line_count = 1
  local col_count = 1
  for i = 1, idx - 1 do
    col_count = col_count + 1
    if str:sub(i, i) == "\n" then
      line_count = line_count + 1
      col_count = 1
    end
  end
  error( string.format("%s at line %d col %d", msg, line_count, col_count) )
end


local function codepoint_to_utf8(n)
  -- http://scripts.sil.org/cms/scripts/page.php?site_id=nrsi&id=iws-appendixa
  local f = math.floor
  if n <= 0x7f then
    return string.char(n)
  elseif n <= 0x7ff then
    return string.char(f(n / 64) + 192, n % 64 + 128)
  elseif n <= 0xffff then
    return string.char(f(n / 4096) + 224, f(n % 4096 / 64) + 128, n % 64 + 128)
  elseif n <= 0x10ffff then
    return string.char(f(n / 262144) + 240, f(n % 262144 / 4096) + 128,
                       f(n % 4096 / 64) + 128, n % 64 + 128)
  end
  error( string.format("invalid unicode codepoint '%x'", n) )
end


local function parse_unicode_escape(s)
  local n1 = tonumber( s:sub(3, 6),  16 )
  local n2 = tonumber( s:sub(9, 12), 16 )
  -- Surrogate pair?
  if n2 then
    return codepoint_to_utf8((n1 - 0xd800) * 0x400 + (n2 - 0xdc00) + 0x10000)
  else
    return codepoint_to_utf8(n1)
  end
end


local function parse_string(str, i)
  local has_unicode_escape = false
  local has_surrogate_escape = false
  local has_escape = false
  local last
  for j = i + 1, #str do
    local x = str:byte(j)

    if x < 32 then
      decode_error(str, j, "control character in string")
    end

    if last == 92 then -- "\\" (escape char)
      if x == 117 then -- "u" (unicode escape sequence)
        local hex = str:sub(j + 1, j + 5)
        if not hex:find("%x%x%x%x") then
          decode_error(str, j, "invalid unicode escape in string")
        end
        if hex:find("^[dD][89aAbB]") then
          has_surrogate_escape = true
        else
          has_unicode_escape = true
        end
      else
        local c = string.char(x)
        if not escape_chars[c] then
          decode_error(str, j, "invalid escape char '" .. c .. "' in string")
        end
        has_escape = true
      end
      last = nil

    elseif x == 34 then -- '"' (end of string)
      local s = str:sub(i + 1, j - 1)
      if has_surrogate_escape then
        s = s:gsub("\\u[dD][89aAbB]..\\u....", parse_unicode_escape)
      end
      if has_unicode_escape then
        s = s:gsub("\\u....", parse_unicode_escape)
      end
      if has_escape then
        s = s:gsub("\\.", escape_char_map_inv)
      end
      return s, j + 1

    else
      last = x
    end
  end
  decode_error(str, i, "expected closing quote for string")
end


local function parse_number(str, i)
  local x = next_char(str, i, delim_chars)
  local s = str:sub(i, x - 1)
  local n = tonumber(s)
  if not n then
    decode_error(str, i, "invalid number '" .. s .. "'")
  end
  return n, x
end


local function parse_literal(str, i)
  local x = next_char(str, i, delim_chars)
  local word = str:sub(i, x - 1)
  if not literals[word] then
    decode_error(str, i, "invalid literal '" .. word .. "'")
  end
  return literal_map[word], x
end


local function parse_array(str, i)
  local res = {}
  local n = 1
  i = i + 1
  while 1 do
    local x
    i = next_char(str, i, space_chars, true)
    -- Empty / end of array?
    if str:sub(i, i) == "]" then
      i = i + 1
      break
    end
    -- Read token
    x, i = parse(str, i)
    res[n] = x
    n = n + 1
    -- Next token
    i = next_char(str, i, space_chars, true)
    local chr = str:sub(i, i)
    i = i + 1
    if chr == "]" then break end
    if chr ~= "," then decode_error(str, i, "expected ']' or ','") end
  end
  return res, i
end


local function parse_object(str, i)
  local res = {}
  i = i + 1
  while 1 do
    local key, val
    i = next_char(str, i, space_chars, true)
    -- Empty / end of object?
    if str:sub(i, i) == "}" then
      i = i + 1
      break
    end
    -- Read key
    if str:sub(i, i) ~= '"' then
      decode_error(str, i, "expected string for key")
    end
    key, i = parse(str, i)
    -- Read ':' delimiter
    i = next_char(str, i, space_chars, true)
    if str:sub(i, i) ~= ":" then
      decode_error(str, i, "expected ':' after key")
    end
    i = next_char(str, i + 1, space_chars, true)
    -- Read value
    val, i = parse(str, i)
    -- Set
    res[key] = val
    -- Next token
    i = next_char(str, i, space_chars, true)
    local chr = str:sub(i, i)
    i = i + 1
    if chr == "}" then break end
    if chr ~= "," then decode_error(str, i, "expected '}' or ','") end
  end
  return res, i
end


local char_func_map = {
  [ '"' ] = parse_string,
  [ "0" ] = parse_number,
  [ "1" ] = parse_number,
  [ "2" ] = parse_number,
  [ "3" ] = parse_number,
  [ "4" ] = parse_number,
  [ "5" ] = parse_number,
  [ "6" ] = parse_number,
  [ "7" ] = parse_number,
  [ "8" ] = parse_number,
  [ "9" ] = parse_number,
  [ "-" ] = parse_number,
  [ "t" ] = parse_literal,
  [ "f" ] = parse_literal,
  [ "n" ] = parse_literal,
  [ "[" ] = parse_array,
  [ "{" ] = parse_object,
}


parse = function(str, idx)
  local chr = str:sub(idx, idx)
  local f = char_func_map[chr]
  if f then
    return f(str, idx)
  end
  decode_error(str, idx, "unexpected character '" .. chr .. "'")
end


function json.decode(str)
  if type(str) ~= "string" then
    error("expected argument of type string, got " .. type(str))
  end
  local res, idx = parse(str, next_char(str, 1, space_chars, true))
  idx = next_char(str, idx, space_chars, true)
  if idx <= #str then
    decode_error(str, idx, "trailing garbage")
  end
  return res
end


local _, namespace = ...
if namespace then namespace.JournalJSON = json end
return json

-- Presets operate on complete trips between service locations. Keep the fastest
-- feasible reference trip wherever transport is mandatory or saves the most time.
local _, ns = ...
local Style = {}
local methods = {"mount","fly","boat","skyship","zeppelin","tram","portal","teleport","device","hearthReady"}
function Style.profile(base, preset)
  local p = {}
  for k,v in pairs(base) do p[k]=v end
  if preset=="foot" then
    for _,key in ipairs(methods) do p[key]=false end
  elseif preset=="mixed" or preset=="full" then
    for _,key in ipairs({"fly","boat","skyship","zeppelin","tram","portal","teleport"}) do p[key]=true end
    -- Equipment, bind readiness, learned spells and discovered masters stay character-specific.
  end
  return p
end

local function walkingTrip(world, profile, origin, destination, cache, stop)
  local start=world:index(origin)
  local search=cache[start]
  if not search then
    local dist,prev,ctx=ns.Router.search(world,profile,start,false)
    search={dist=dist,prev=prev,ctx=ctx};cache[start]=search
  end
  local state=ns.Router.sid(search.ctx,world:index(destination),0)
  if not search.dist[state] then return nil end
  local reverse={}
  while search.prev[state] do
    local step=search.prev[state]
    local from=ns.Router.decode(search.ctx,step.state)
    local to=ns.Router.decode(search.ctx,state)
    reverse[#reverse+1]={kind="travel",mode="walk",from=world.nodes[from].id,to=world.nodes[to].id,
      path=step.edge.geometry,seconds=search.dist[state]-search.dist[step.state],stopId=stop.id,quest=stop.quest}
    state=step.state
  end
  local legs={}
  for i=#reverse,1,-1 do legs[#legs+1]=reverse[i] end
  return legs
end

function Style.apply(result, req, makeWorld)
  local style=req.profile.travelPreset
  if style~="mixed" and style~="full" and style~="foot" then return result end
  local groups,eligible,mandatory,options={},{},0,{}
  local world,profile,cache=nil,nil,{}
  if style=="mixed" then world,profile=makeWorld({graph=req.graph,profile=Style.profile(req.profile,"foot")}) end
  local index=1
  for i,stop in ipairs(result.stops) do
    local group={legs={},seconds=0}
    groups[i]=group
    while result.legs[index].kind=="travel" do
      local leg=result.legs[index]
      group.legs[#group.legs+1]=leg
      group.seconds=group.seconds+leg.seconds
      if leg.mode~="walk" then group.transport=true end
      index=index+1
    end
    group.service=result.legs[index]; index=index+1
    if group.transport then
      eligible[#eligible+1]=i
      if world then
        local walk=walkingTrip(world,profile,group.legs[1].from,stop.place,cache,stop)
        if walk then
          local seconds=0
          for _,leg in ipairs(walk) do seconds=seconds+leg.seconds end
          options[#options+1]={index=i,walk=walk,saving=seconds-group.seconds}
        else mandatory=mandatory+1 end
      end
    end
  end
  local enabled=#eligible
  if style=="mixed" then
    enabled=math.max(mandatory,math.ceil(#eligible/2))
    table.sort(options,function(a,b)
      if a.saving==b.saving then return a.index<b.index end
      return a.saving>b.saving
    end)
    for rank=enabled-mandatory+1,#options do
      local o=options[rank]; groups[o.index].legs=o.walk
    end
    result.legs={}; result.travelSeconds=0
    local elapsed=0
    for i,g in ipairs(groups) do
      for _,leg in ipairs(g.legs) do
        elapsed=elapsed+leg.seconds;leg.endsAt=elapsed
        result.legs[#result.legs+1]=leg;result.travelSeconds=result.travelSeconds+leg.seconds
      end
      elapsed=elapsed+g.service.seconds;g.service.endsAt=elapsed
      result.legs[#result.legs+1]=g.service;result.stops[i].endsAt=elapsed
    end
    result.totalCostSeconds=elapsed
    result.isProvenOptimal=false
  end
  result.travelStyle={preset=style,eligibleTrips=#eligible,transportTrips=enabled,mandatoryTrips=mandatory}
  return result
end

-- The host supplies a repository projection and a profile. No frame, clock or VM globals.
local _, ns = ...
local Planner = {}
local function errorResult(code, message, ids)
  return {status="error", code=code, message=message, uncoveredRequiredIds=ids or {}, legs={}, stops={}, isProvenOptimal=false}
end

-- Each service is the edge (location, covered) -> (location, covered + id).
-- The 'after' list guards that transition. Counts already completed do not create work.
local function services(req, world)
  local stops, byQuest, final = {}, {}, {}
  local omitted = {}
  for _,id in ipairs(req.omitted or {}) do omitted[id]=true end
  local function add(q,kind,site,work,after,obj)
    local id=q.id.."/"..(obj and obj.id or kind)
    stops[#stops+1]={id=id,quest=q.id,kind=kind,node=world.byId[site],place=site,work=work,
      after=after,objective=obj and obj.id,target=obj and obj.count,
      label=obj and obj.label or (kind=="visit" and (q.waypoint and ("Arrive at "..q.title) or ("Reach staging point for "..q.title))) or ((kind=="accept" and "Accept " or "Turn in ")..q.title)}
    byQuest[q.id][#byQuest[q.id]+1]=#stops
    return #stops
  end
  for _,q in ipairs(req.quests) do
    local state=req.progress[q.id] or {}
    byQuest[q.id]={}
    if q.navigationOnly then
      add(q,"visit",q.giver,1,{})
    elseif not state.turnedIn then
      local base={}
      if not state.accepted then base[1]=add(q,"accept",q.giver,4,{}) end
      local parents,partial={},false
      for _,i in ipairs(base) do parents[#parents+1]=i end
      for _,o in ipairs(q.objectives) do
        local remaining=o.count-((state.counts or {})[o.id] or 0)
        if remaining>0 then
          if omitted[q.id.."/"..o.id] then partial=true
          else parents[#parents+1]=add(q,"objective",o.place,remaining*o.seconds,base,o) end
        end
      end
      if not partial then final[q.id]=add(q,"turnin",q.turnin,5,parents) end
    end
  end
  for _,q in ipairs(req.quests) do
    for _,p in ipairs(q.requires or {}) do
      if not (req.progress[p] or {}).turnedIn then
        if not final[p] then return nil,errorResult("prerequisite","Include and finish "..p.." before "..q.title..".",{q.id,p}) end
        for _,i in ipairs(byQuest[q.id]) do
          -- Each vertex needs its own guards, even when several children share an accept.
          local copy={}
          for _,v in ipairs(stops[i].after) do copy[#copy+1]=v end
          copy[#copy+1]=final[p]; stops[i].after=copy
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return stops
end

local azeroth
local function makeWorld(req)
  if req.graph.version=="azeroth-v1" then
    if not azeroth then
      azeroth=ns.WorldData.build(ns.World)
      function azeroth:allowed(edge,profile)
        local mode=edge.mode
        if mode=="board" or mode=="land" then mode="fly" end
        if mode~="walk" and not profile.methods[mode] then return false end
        if mode=="fly" and profile.flights then
          for _,index in ipairs({edge.from,edge.to}) do
            local node=self.nodes[index]
            if node.ground and not profile.flights[self.nodes[node.ground].id] then return false end
          end
        end
        return ns.World.allowed(self,edge,profile)
      end
    end
    local p=req.profile
    local known=nil
    if p.knownFlights then known={}; for _,id in ipairs(p.knownFlights) do known[id]=true end end
    local spells=nil
    if p.knownSpells then spells={}; for _,id in ipairs(p.knownSpells) do spells[id]=true end end
    return azeroth,{methods=p,flights=known,knows=spells and function(id) return spells[id] end,
      speed=p.mount and 11.2 or 7,class=string.upper(p.class),faction=p.faction,bind=p.hearth,
      hearth=p.hearthReady and p.hearth or nil,items={[18984]=p.ripper,[18986]=p.transporter}}
  end
  local w=ns.World.new()
  local p=req.profile
  for _,loc in ipairs(req.graph.places) do w:addPlace({id=loc.id}) end
  for _,e in ipairs(req.graph.edges) do
    if e.mode=="walk" or p[e.mode] then
      local cost=e.seconds
      if e.mode=="walk" and p.mount then cost=cost/1.6 end
      local edge=w:edge(w:index(e.from),w:index(e.to),e.mode,cost,{faction=e.faction,class=e.class})
      edge.geometry=e.path
    end
  end
  if req.graph.version=="westreach-1" then
    if w.byId.haven and p.teleport and p.class=="Mage" then
      w:addTeleport({to="haven",mode="teleport",cost=8,name="Recall to the inn"})
    end
    if w.byId.mill and p.device then
      w:addTeleport({to="mill",mode="device",cost=9,limited=true,name="Waystone"})
    end
  end
  return w,{speed=1,class=p.class,faction=p.faction,hearth=p.hearthReady and p.hearth or nil}
end

local function available(stops,j,done)
  if done[j] then return false end
  for _,parent in ipairs(stops[j].after) do if not done[parent] then return false end end
  return true
end

-- A local DAG of at most three new coverage transitions. Candidate states strictly
-- increase coverage. Each deadhead is a Dijkstra connector with a disjoint resource mask.
local function guided(M,stops,depth)
  local order,done,spent,at={},{},0,0
  for round=1,#stops do
    local best
    local function extend(origin,used,level,cost,first,firstSpend)
      local alternatives={}
      for j=1,#stops do
        if available(stops,j,done) then
          for c=0,M.S-1 do
            local travel=M.D[origin][j][c+1]
            if ns.Bits.band(used,c)==0 and travel<math.huge then
              alternatives[#alternatives+1]={j=j,c=c,cost=travel+stops[j].work}
            end
          end
        end
      end
      table.sort(alternatives,function(a,b)
        if a.cost~=b.cost then return a.cost<b.cost end
        if a.j~=b.j then return a.j<b.j end
        return a.c<b.c
      end)
      for i=1,math.min(#alternatives,5) do
        local a=alternatives[i]
        local total=cost+a.cost
        local start=first or a.j
        local initial=firstSpend or a.c
        if level==1 or total<=110 then
          if not best or level>best.depth or (level==best.depth and total<best.cost) then
            best={depth=level,cost=total,first=start,spend=initial}
          end
          if level<depth and total<110 then
            done[a.j]=true; extend(a.j,used+a.c,level+1,total,start,initial); done[a.j]=nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
    extend(at,spent,1,0)
    if not best then return nil end
    at=best.first; spent=spent+best.spend; done[at]=true; order[round]=at
  end
  return order
end

-- Factory Method: run() is inherited. Each creator chooses its strategy by overriding
-- createStrategy; the common client accepts independently supplied creator objects.
local Creator={}
function Creator:run(M,stops) return self:createStrategy():calculate(M,stops) end
function Planner.creator(factory)
  return setmetatable({createStrategy=factory},{__index=Creator})
end
local function guidedStrategy(depth)
  return {calculate=function(_,M,s) return guided(M,s,depth) end}
end
Planner.creators={
 atlas=Planner.creator(function() return guidedStrategy(3) end),
 nearest=Planner.creator(function() return guidedStrategy(1) end),
 exact=Planner.creator(function() return {calculate=function(_,M,s) return ns.Tour.exact(M,s) end} end)
}

function Planner.chain(checks)
  local function visit(i,ctx)
    if checks[i] then return checks[i](ctx) or visit(i+1,ctx) end
  end
  return function(ctx) return visit(1,ctx) end
end
local validate=Planner.chain({
 function(c)
   local found={}
   for _,q in ipairs(c.r.quests) do
     if q.faction and q.faction~=c.r.profile.faction then return errorResult("faction",q.title.." requires an "..q.faction.." character.",{q.id}) end
     if found[q.id] then return errorResult("selection","A quest is selected twice.",{q.id}) end
     found[q.id]=true
   end
 end,
 function(c)
   local loc={}
   for _,p in ipairs(c.r.graph.places) do loc[p.id]=true end
   if not loc[c.r.profile.start] then return errorResult("coordinate","Choose a known starting point.") end
   c.locations=loc
 end,
 function(c)
   local has={}
   for _,q in ipairs(c.r.quests) do has[q.id]=true end
   for _,q in ipairs(c.r.quests) do
     for _,id in ipairs(q.requires) do
       if not has[id] and not (c.r.progress[id] or {}).turnedIn then return errorResult("prerequisite","Include prerequisite "..id.." for "..q.title..".",{q.id,id}) end
     end
   end
 end,
 function(c)
   local p=c.r.profile
   if p.hearthReady and not c.locations[p.hearth] then return errorResult("transport","Choose a valid hearthstone bind.") end
   for _,e in ipairs(c.r.graph.edges) do
     if not c.locations[e.from] or not c.locations[e.to] or type(e.seconds)~="number" or e.seconds<0 or e.seconds~=e.seconds or e.seconds==math.huge then return errorResult("graph","Invalid travel connection.") end
   end
   c.world,c.profile=makeWorld(c.r)
 end,
 function(c)
   local err
   c.stops,err=services(c.r,c.world)
   if err then return err end
   for _,s in ipairs(c.stops) do
     if not s.node or not c.locations[s.place] then
       return errorResult("coordinate","Location not available for "..s.label,{s.id})
     end
   end
   if #c.stops>120 then return errorResult("bound","Select at most 120 outstanding services per plan.") end
   c.M=ns.Tour.matrices(c.world,c.profile,c.world:index(c.r.profile.start),c.stops)
   local blocked={}
   for i,s in ipairs(c.stops) do if math.min(unpack(c.M.D[0][i]))==math.huge then blocked[#blocked+1]=s.id end end
   if #blocked>0 then return errorResult("unreachable","No permitted connection to "..table.concat(blocked,", ")..". Change travel unlocks or remove the quest.",blocked) end
 end
})

function Planner.plan(req,creators)
  local request={}
  for k,v in pairs(req) do request[k]=v end
  request.profile=ns.JourneyTravelStyle.profile(req.profile,req.profile.travelPreset)
  req=request
  local c={r=req}
  local err=validate(c); if err then return err end
  local M,stops=c.M,c.stops
  local algo=req.algorithm
  local creator=(creators or Planner.creators)[algo]
  if not creator then return errorResult("strategy","Unknown routing strategy.") end
  if algo=="exact" and (#stops>12 or not ns.Tour.exactAffordable(#stops,M.S)) then
    return errorResult("bound","Exact search exceeds the bounded state budget. Select fewer services.")
  end
  local order={}
  if #stops>0 then order=creator:run(M,stops) end
  if not order or #order~=#stops or not ns.Tour.feasible(order,stops) then
    local ids={}; for _,s in ipairs(stops) do ids[#ids+1]=s.id end
    if algo=="exact" then return errorResult("unreachable","No complete route satisfies these restrictions.",ids) end
    return errorResult("no_extension","This strategy could not finish the route. Try exact search for a small selection or change travel options.",ids)
  end
  local total,spend=ns.Tour.orderCost(M,order,stops)
  if total==math.huge then
    return errorResult("no_extension","The proposed order cannot be reached with the available travel resources.")
  end
  local r={status="ok",algorithmId=algo,isProvenOptimal=algo=="exact",graphVersion=req.graph.version,requiredCount=#stops,
    coveredCount=#order,totalCostSeconds=total,travelSeconds=0,workSeconds=0,legs={},stops={},warnings={"Travel times, road connections and map geometry are estimates."}}
  local prev,elapsed=0,0
  for k,j in ipairs(order) do
    local s=stops[j]
    local res=M.cache[M.pts[prev]]
    local v=ns.Router.sid(M.ctx,s.node,spend[k])
    local reverse={}
    while res.prev[v] do
      local step=res.prev[v]
      local from=ns.Router.decode(M.ctx,step.state)
      local to=ns.Router.decode(M.ctx,v)
      reverse[#reverse+1]={kind="travel",mode=step.edge.mode,from=c.world.nodes[c.world.nodes[from].ground or from].id,to=c.world.nodes[c.world.nodes[to].ground or to].id,methodName=step.edge.name,
        path=step.edge.geometry,seconds=res.dist[v]-res.dist[step.state],stopId=s.id,quest=s.quest}
      v=step.state
    end
    for i=#reverse,1,-1 do
      local leg=reverse[i]; if leg.mode=="board" or leg.mode=="land" then leg.phase=leg.mode;leg.mode="fly" end; if leg.mode=="walk" and req.profile.mount then leg.mode="ride" end
      elapsed=elapsed+leg.seconds; leg.endsAt=elapsed;r.travelSeconds=r.travelSeconds+leg.seconds
      r.legs[#r.legs+1]=leg
    end
    elapsed=elapsed+s.work; r.workSeconds=r.workSeconds+s.work
    r.legs[#r.legs+1]={kind="service",mode=s.kind,from=s.place,to=s.place,seconds=s.work,endsAt=elapsed,stopId=s.id,quest=s.quest,objective=s.objective,target=s.target}
    r.stops[k]={id=s.id,quest=s.quest,kind=s.kind,label=s.label,place=s.place,work=s.work,endsAt=elapsed,objective=s.objective}
    prev=j
  end
  return ns.JourneyTravelStyle.apply(r,req,makeWorld)
end
ns.JourneyPlanner=Planner
